reviews.lens: Boutique recruiter operational fit: affected-finding follow-up on immutable GET-5-product-v2, baseline d363ac04 plus manifest-frozen implementation. Synthetic independent recruiter continuing a mobile note through contact review, deliberate saving, restart and one fork. This packet reassesses its own v1 findings and adjacent proof; field usefulness and deployment are outside the directly observed evidence.

findings.criterion: Write safety: the pending-save footer still describes an unsubmitted proposal
findings.observation: Supported code risk, residual of v1 finding 1: the main unknown-save error is now truthful, but the card footer still chooses “Proposed only · nothing changes until you confirm” whenever saveMessage is nil. A current pending write after a lost response has exactly that state. The footer does not branch on hasPendingWrite, although the title, banner and retry button do. This remains misleading after the recruiter already confirmed and the server may have committed. The new screenshots stop above the footer, so this is not claimed as a directly observed screenshot defect.
findings.evidence: /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:5049-5055 selects the corrected unknown result without setting saveMessage; :5733-5749 selects the first-save footer solely from isCurrent/saveMessage; :6447-6451 uses hasPendingWrite for the retry title. /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:5035-5041 only asserts contact-save-error, not contact-proposal-boundary. The observed main-message correction is visible in /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/screenshots/24-authenticated-unknown-save-v2.png; its recovery case passes at /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:561.
findings.user_impact: Supported operational inference: the recruiter can encounter a second, incompatible description of the operation while scrolling to the save/retry area. The prominent corrected message substantially reduces the v1 problem, but the footer can still suggest that the first confirmation has not occurred.
findings.recommendation: For a current card with hasPendingWrite and no receipt, choose a submitted/unknown-result footer before the proposal-only branch, for example “Submitted · check the original save for its result”. Keep the original operation locked. This is a copy-state correction; no new capability is needed.
findings.verification: Extend the existing authenticated after-commit response-loss/relaunch test to reveal contact-proposal-boundary before and after relaunch. Assert that its text describes an uncertain submitted operation and contains neither “Proposed only” nor a new-confirmation assurance. Keep the original receipt, same-operation retry and People-readback checks. Capture the full recovery card including its footer.

findings.observation: Residual from v1 finding 3, confirmed in the frozen rendering branch: while hasPendingWrite is true and saveMessage is nil, the footer still selects 'Proposed only · nothing changes until you confirm'. The user has already confirmed the protected operation, whose outcome may be committed but unknown. The primary error and prominent original-operation notice are now accurate. findings.evidence: /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:5733-5744 (footer lacks a pending branch), :5049-5053 (corrected error), :5670-5683 (retry notice); evidence/screenshots/24-authenticated-unknown-save-v2.png; source/apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:5035-5039 tests the primary error but not the footer; evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:561 records that native case passing. findings.user_impact: A recruiter who scrolls to the footer receives an inaccurate description of an already-approved operation. This does not revive the prior deletion or retention vetoes.
findings.recommendation: Choose a pending-write footer before the unconfirmed-proposal branch, describing the original save as awaiting reconciliation. Keep the proposed-only footer for drafts that have never been submitted.
findings.verification: In the existing authenticated response-loss test, scroll to contact-proposal-boundary and assert that it describes reconciliation without saying the operation is still only proposed. Original-operation retry and the restored canonical receipt must remain unchanged.
